name: LogoSwap
description: Swap the default Jellyfin logo with your own custom branding.
overview: Upload a custom logo to replace Jellyfin branding throughout the interface.

versions.changelog: Fix Jellyfin 12 header and drawer logo sizing, including ElegantFin and mobile layouts. Support configured Base URLs and nested paths (Ref #4). Add separate PNG, ICO, and SVG favicons (Ref #3). Require administrator authentication for uploads and deletions. After updating, restart Jellyfin, apply the logo to branding again, and hard refresh your browser.
Fix plugin thumbnail display, double file dialog, auto-upload on file select, and logo transparency preservation.
Simplified CSS injection - cleaner generated CSS, removed redundant selectors.
Initial release. Upload custom logos, auto-inject via branding settings, Jellyfin 10.11 compatible.
